entries.note: When a limit or allocation fails, the frame keeps its accepted prefix and drops every later command instead of failing the frame, so partial output stays in order and the overflow flag can be reported. Text is copied into the list's arena because views pass per-cell stack buffers; the arena NUL-terminates each run so adapters can hand strings to C APIs directly.

entries.note: The owner chose a gradient primitive over a texture during the F60 interview (spec 076 decision 7), which took the draw-list contract to version 2. The command carries two stops, the axis in flags, and the same radius and corner mask an rrect takes, so a rounded track needs no separate shape. The ramp itself is not left to each adapter: re_gradient_sample in the header is the definition, and every adapter steps through it, which is what lets the cross-backend comparison treat a gradient like any other primitive.
